method.matching: Actual entry calendar date, unique per account; matched entry prices asserted identical.
method.windows: ALL ends 2026-10-15; WITHOUT2026 truly truncates at 2025-12-31, including open positions marked at that account close with no hypothetical exit fee.
method.cohorts: Year tables group by actual entry year, not natural-year account PnL. Annual NAV statistics are separate and include previous year last NAV in drawdown.
method.position_return: Actual sale net proceeds / actual purchase including fee - 1; open holdings marked at account closing price without sale fee.
method.cycle_return: Residual cash plus net sale/mark proceeds divided by pre-entry entire account cash - 1. Product exactly reconciles account NAV; residual-cash log difference can be positive or negative.
method.attribution: Matched and unmatched log terms describe realized paths; matched cycle log differences still depend on path-specific quantities/residual cash. Entry replacement terms are not independent causal effects.
method.no_additive_returns: Arithmetic trade percentages and positive/negative sums are distribution diagnostics, never additive account return. Only log wealth terms add in the explicitly reconciled decomposition.
method.trim: Remove highest individual closed trade returns or matched return differences, recompute arithmetic mean only; no tradable counterfactual account.
method.pnl_groups: H3 actual exit net PnL is known only after next-session execution, not at the prior evening exit decision. Grouping is retrospective, not an executable conditional switch.
method.same_entry_extension: Same entry matches compare actual H6/H3 exits, including genuine exit delays. They do not imply that the entire H6 account consists of simply extending every H3 trade.
